public_api.note: Release 0.4.0b1 adds LOT-20 Financial Analysis as a deterministic read-only bounded context over sealed reporting/accounting facts. It provides versioned indicator/ratio definitions, explicit CALCULATED/NOT_APPLICABLE/UNDEFINED/INDETERMINATE/ERROR outcomes, SIG/EBE/EBITDA/CAF examples, functional-balance and FRNG/BFR/Net-Treasury mechanics, historical ratios, trends, diagnostics, CalculationTrace and replayable AnalysisSnapshot evidence. Analysis never mutates the ledger or reporting source, does not infer semantics from account-number prefixes, and excludes Corporate Finance concepts such as NPV/IRR/WACC/DCF/valuation. The public Python API remains intentionally unfrozen before 1.0.
